migration.accepted_result: Saved reports reproduced on arm64 from saved draws: all decisions, flags, labels, counts and input manifests identical; ceiling/primary/comparison floats within 3.5e-11 relative; predictive_report.json reproduced except floating-point tie classification.
migration.qualification: predictive_report.json tails (less/equal/greater) use exact float equality; cross-machine roundoff moved near-tie draws between categories: at most 21 (venture) and 50 (hiring) of 16000 draws; one ~3.5e-15 median differs at the 15th decimal. No descriptive_review_flag or interpretation changed. Pre-stated criterion status remains DIFFERS for these two files; not relabelled as equal.

multiplicity.family_definition: Nine RQ1/RQ2 contrasts plus one RQ6 slope per pool; six matched RQ5 contrasts. Matched menu-size slope is sensitivity only, not an additional RQ6 primary family. RQ3 and RQ4 are descriptive.

report_substitutions.fit_loader: Projection-backed fit (structural columns, all rows, hash-verified) plus full-chain y_pred/alpha_obs/log_lik; CmdStan metadata paths relocated in memory.
report_substitutions.predictive_checks.build_predictive_repor: Archived BatchedPredictiveReport over the passed arrays; per-fit 7-draw exact probe against the canonical calculator.

combination.policy: Exact Cartesian product up to cap; otherwise independent whole-draw resampling with replacement. No aligned-chain or matched-row pairing across pools.

stable.interpretation: Preregistered position-bias robustness read: realized primary contrasts and gamma_size recomputed on the size-balanced position-stable subset and compared with the primary fit for sign stability. Decision-rule labels are annotations only; the subset is outcome-selected and is not a dependence correction.

status: Generated from local result artifacts by analysis/study_results_evidence.py --refresh; do not edit.
summary_qualifications: Decisions follow the frozen contract; sensitivity fits annotate but never replace primary decisions.
Predictive flags are descriptive in-sample checks, not gates or multiplicity-controlled discoveries.
Fits span two machines (x86_64 archived, arm64 new); not bitwise comparable across machines.
Structural quantities come from verified projections; per-observation arrays from full chains.
